items.q: What does an insurance broker do?
items.a: A broker compares plans from multiple insurance companies and recommends the best fit for your situation. Unlike an agent, we don't work for one insurer — we work for you.
Yes. You pay the standard premium set by the insurer; our service costs you nothing extra.

items.q: Which insurance companies can you quote?
items.a: We work with over 20 insurers operating in Laos, including Allianz, AIA, Phongsavanh, Prudential, MSIG, Toyota Insurance and more.

items.q: How long does it take to get a quote?
items.a: Most simple quotes come back within 24 hours. Complex cases (business, high-value property) can take a few business days.

items.q: Can you help with a claim?
items.a: Yes — that's a big part of what we do. We help you file the claim, gather documents, and follow up with the insurer until it's resolved.

items.q: What languages do you work in?
items.a: We serve clients in Lao, English, and Thai. Just let us know your preference when you reach out.

ctaBand.title: Not sure where to start?
ctaBand.body: Talk to an advisor today. We'll help you figure out what you actually need — no sales pitch.
